entries.title: Psalms 139:1
segments: ¶<To the chief music-maker. A Psalm. Of David.> O Lord, you have knowledge of me, searching out all my secrets.

entries.title: Psalms 139:2
segments: You have knowledge when I am seated and when I get up, you see my thoughts from far away.

entries.title: Psalms 139:3
segments: You keep watch over my steps and my sleep, and have knowledge of all my ways.

entries.title: Psalms 139:4
segments: For there is not a word on my tongue which is not clear to you, O Lord.

entries.title: Psalms 139:5
segments: I am shut in by you on every side, and you have put your hand on me.

entries.title: Psalms 139:6
segments: Such knowledge is a wonder greater than my powers; it is so high that I may not come near it.

entries.title: Psalms 139:7
segments: ¶Where may I go from your spirit? how may I go in flight from you?

entries.title: Psalms 139:8
segments: If I go up to heaven, you are there: or if I make my bed in the underworld, you are there.

entries.title: Psalms 139:9
segments: If I take the wings of the morning, and go to the farthest parts of the sea;

entries.title: Psalms 139:10
segments: Even there will I be guided by your hand, and your right hand will keep me.

entries.title: Psalms 139:11
segments: If I say, Only let me be covered by the dark, and the light about me be night;

entries.title: Psalms 139:12
segments: Even the dark is not dark to you; the night is as bright as the day: for dark and light are the same to you.

entries.title: Psalms 139:13
segments: My flesh was made by you, and my parts joined together in my mother's body.

entries.title: Psalms 139:14
segments: I will give you praise, for I am strangely and delicately formed; your works are great wonders, and of this my soul is fully conscious.

entries.title: Psalms 139:15
segments: My frame was not unseen by you when I was made secretly, and strangely formed in the lowest parts of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 139:16
segments: Your eyes saw my unformed substance; in your book all my days were recorded, even those which were purposed before they had come into being.

entries.title: Psalms 139:17
segments: ¶How dear are your thoughts to me, O God! how great is the number of them!

entries.title: Psalms 139:18
segments: If I made up their number, it would be more than the grains of sand; when I am awake, I am still with you.

entries.title: Psalms 139:19
segments: If only you would put the sinners to death, O God; go far from me, you men of blood.

entries.title: Psalms 139:20
segments: For they go against you with evil designs, and your haters make sport of your name.

entries.title: Psalms 139:21
segments: Are not your haters hated by me, O Lord? are not those who are lifted up against you a cause of grief to me?

entries.title: Psalms 139:22
segments: My hate for them is complete; my thoughts of them are as if they were making war on me.

entries.title: Psalms 139:23
segments: O God, let the secrets of my heart be uncovered, and let my wandering thoughts be tested:

entries.title: Psalms 139:24
segments: See if there is any way of sorrow in me, and be my guide in the eternal way.
